gaps.explanation: Statement p4 (Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds, GAAP): Total revenues General Fund 62,131,983, Streets Fund 11,183,691, Other Governmental Funds 6,976,874 = 80,292,548. Detail: General Fund Budgetary Comparison Schedule (p9) Total Revenues 62,050,213, Streets Fund schedule (p10) 11,379,812, nonmajor combining statement (pp11-13) 6,976,874 (ties to the Other Governmental Funds column) = 80,406,899. Gap -114,351 = (62,131,983 - 62,050,213 = 81,770) - (11,379,812 - 11,183,691 = 196,121). Budgetary basis vs GAAP; both printed totals, no fix.

Statement p4 Total expenditures: General 43,947,161, Streets 21,689,934, Other Governmental 9,660,907 = 75,298,002. Statement p4 prints transfers gross: Transfers in General 2,833,621, Streets 7,179,500, Other Governmental 3,347,890 = 13,361,011. The budgetary schedules print only 'Operating transfers, net': General (13,342,634) (p9) = 2,833,621 - 16,176,255, Streets 6,579,500 (p10) = 7,179,500 - 600,000. Detail therefore holds Streets net 6,579,500 as in + nonmajor 3,347,890 = 9,927,390. Gap 3,433,621 = General transfers in 2,833,621 + Streets transfers out 600,000 that the schedules net away. Schedules net interfund transfers; no gross amounts printed on them; no fix.

Statement p4 Transfers out: General (16,176,255), Streets (600,000), Other Governmental (665,134) = 17,441,389. Detail: General 'Operating transfers, net' (13,342,634) (p9) + nonmajor (665,134) = 14,007,768. Gap 3,433,621 = (16,176,255 - 13,342,634 = 2,833,621) + Streets 600,000, i.e. the same amounts netted in the schedules (mirror of the transfers_in gap). No fix.
